description: This file defines utility functions to build session hook payloads and contexts for session start and end events within an OpenClaw project. It makes use of imported external types and functions to resolve session agent IDs and structure event data.

methods.name: function buildSessionHookContext(params: { buildSessionHookContext
methods.description: Constructs a SessionHookContext object containing session ID, session key, and agent ID based on provided parameters.

methods.name: export function buildSessionStartHookPayload(params: { buildSessionStartHookPayload
methods.description: Builds a payload for a session start event, including event details and context.

methods.name: export function buildSessionEndHookPayload(params: { buildSessionEndHookPayload
methods.description: Builds a payload for a session end event, including event details, reason, and context.
